pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding authorized within 50 pips or 15 minutes of a prior entry; block multi-ticket clustering to prevent correlated cascade failures.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a validated ATR-based volatility envelope breakout confirmation and zero high-impact calendar news within a 15-minute window before executing orders.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively lock in gains via dynamic trailing stops once floating profit crosses +$10.00 to prevent evaporation into negative closures.
